## pivot_wider()

```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(cancensus)
renter_csd_van <- get_census("CA16", list(CMA="59933"), level="CSD", 
                             vectors = c("v_CA16_4838", "v_CA16_4836")) 

renter_l <- renter_csd_van |> select(`Region Name`, `v_CA16_4838: Renter`, `v_CA16_4836: Total - Private households by tenure - 25% sample data`) |> pivot_longer(-`Region Name`, names_to = "vector")

renter_l |> write_rds("data/renter_l.rds")
```

```{r}
renter_l <- read_rds("data/renter_l.rds")
```


::: {.scroll-output}

::: {.tiny}
```{r echo=FALSE}
renter_l |> kable()
```
:::
:::


::: {.notes}
[Sources]

- Course source: `../docs_2026/19_pivoting.Rmd`.
:::

---


Calculate renter share for each CSD

```{r echo=FALSE}
renter_l |> pivot_wider(`Region Name`, names_from = "vector") |> 
  transmute(`Region Name`, renter_share = `v_CA16_4838: Renter`/`v_CA16_4836: Total - Private households by tenure - 25% sample data`) |> arrange(-renter_share) |> kable()
```


::: {.notes}
[Sources]

- Course source: `../docs_2026/19_pivoting.Rmd`.

## pivot_longer()

```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
pindex <- cansim::get_cansim("18-10-0205-01")

pindex_w <- pindex |> 
  filter(`New housing price indexes` == "Total (house and land)", 
         GEO |> str_detect("Vancouver|Toronto|Montréal|Victoria|Edmonton|Calgary"),
         lubridate::ym(REF_DATE) >= lubridate::ymd("2016-12-01")) |> 
  select(REF_DATE, GEO, VALUE) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = REF_DATE, values_from = VALUE) |> 
	select(GEO:`2026-02`)

pindex_w |> write_rds("data/pindex_w.rds")
```

```{r}
pindex_w <- read_rds("data/pindex_w.rds")
```


::: {.scroll-output-80}

::: {.tiny}
```{r echo=FALSE}
pindex_w |> kable()
```
:::
:::


::: {.notes}
[Sources]

- Course source: `../docs_2026/19_pivoting.Rmd`.
:::

---


Generate this plot.

```{r echo=FALSE}
pindex_w |> pivot_longer( cols = `2016-12`:`2026-02`, names_to = "month") |> 
  mutate(month=lubridate::ym(month)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(month, value, color=GEO)) + geom_line()  + labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, color=NULL) +
  theme_bw()
```


::: {.notes}
[Sources]

- Course source: `../docs_2026/19_pivoting.Rmd`.
:::
